authority_levels.rule: Retained game/source material may define investigation mechanics, examples, narrative structures and content only to the extent explicitly supported and attributable.
Merged MV-IA/PPIA contracts define implementation boundaries, permissions, recovery and feature semantics even when not recovered game-source canon.
PPIA-09 may normalize source-supported concepts and fill explicit product-design gaps, but every such addition must remain labeled governed design rather than source canon.
AI suggestions, inferred connections, generated clues/theories and speculative solvability advice remain proposals until an authorized action accepts them.

domain_handoffs.ppia09_may: deepen authoring contracts and add source-grounded mystery-construction/validation layers
domain_handoffs.ppia09_may_not: erase verified F011 truth, privacy, recovery or accessibility invariants

domain_handoffs.scope: Campaign, Scene, Session, Scene location/placement, snapshots, live amendments and Campaign-local history

domain_handoffs.ppia09_may: use object references and investigation-specific projections

blocking_guardrails: Player-visible information must not be treated as objective truth merely because it is visible.

Permissions and hidden-information filtering apply before protected truth, clues, edges, sources or counts are resolved, queried, searched, exported, emitted in realtime, diagnosed, notified or supplied to AI context.
Objective truth and GM solution content are filtered before query, search, counts, exports, realtime payloads, diagnostics, notifications and AI context.
Player hypothesis creation cannot mutate objective truth or authoritative source-domain objects.
A contradiction is an authored relationship requiring review; it is not an automatic truth adjudicator.
False leads and corrupted evidence remain attributable authored content and cannot silently rewrite truth.
Evidence keeps owning-domain identity and provenance; PPIA-09 stores references and case-local investigation state.
World/Setting chronology and timeline truth stay PPIA-12-owned and do not automatically become Player-known Investigation chronology or timeline facts.
Investigation/Research/Knowledge ability mechanics remain rules-domain behavior; PPIA-09 does not invent missing universal formulas.
Dynamic/extra clue delivery retains trigger/delivery reason, author/source, audience and Event provenance.
Solvability/redundancy checks may be governed design but may not be presented as recovered source canon where the source supplies only guidance.
Spatial clue-board layout remains non-authoritative presentation state with equivalent typed textual relationships.
AI-generated organization, connections, theories, clue suggestions or mystery material remain proposals until explicitly accepted by an authorized user.
All authoritative Investigation mutations inherit expected-version plus operation-ID recovery semantics.
No PPIA-09 artifact activates application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, release, deployment, tester access, paid services or production credentials.
